claims.statement: Charlie Gallagher knocked out Tom Allen in the second round; Allen blamed a snow-filled hole he stepped into.
claims.excerpt: That settled the fight. I was kEnocked out.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I do say that it was a chance blow which defeated me
quotes.topic: chance blow in his defeat by Gallagher

fights.excerpt: That settled the fight. I was kEnocked out.
fights.notes: Allen's own account: he had the better of the first round, then slipped into a snow-filled hole in the second. The date of the bout is not given in the text (the hint's 1869 is not in the text).
